curriculum_framework_source.title: Curriculum Framework of General Education and Technical Education
curriculum_framework_source.publisher: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS) / ក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា

important_caveats: The MoEYS Curriculum Framework identifies grade-level subject structure, learning outcomes, and study hours, but does not provide a consolidated unit-count table for every subject and grade.

Exact counts must be transcribed from the table of contents of the applicable official textbook or detailed syllabus edition. Do not infer unit counts from online video lesson counts or from the number of books in a SALA grade collection.

While the 2016 framework groups Science (6h) and Social Studies (7h) as integrated macro-domains in Lower Secondary, MoEYS officially authors, prints, and distributes distinct student textbooks for Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Earth & Environmental Science, History, Geography, and Moral-Civics.
School timetables operate between 33 core periods (examinable curriculum) and 40 periods (comprehensive framework including PE, ICT, Health, Arts, and Local Life Skills).

lower_secondary_grades_7_to_9.source_note: Framework Table 4 (pp. 24-25). Practical public school core timetable schedules 33 periods.
